1. **Keep a consistent sleep schedule.** Go to bed and wake up at the same times every day, even on weekends. This reinforces your body's circadian rhythm and makes falling asleep easier.

2. **Make your bedroom cool, dark, and quiet.** Aim for around 65–68°F (18–20°C), use blackout curtains or an eye mask, and eliminate noise with earplugs or a fan. A comfortable environment signals to your brain that it's time to wind down.
